summary: Enhance your skills with our International M&E for Development Results Course. Learn effective monitoring and evaluation techniques for impactful results.
lede: Monitoring and evaluation for development results helps programme and evaluation professionals link activities to outcomes and assess evidence of change. The course supports those designing or strengthening programme systems to build a Theory of Change and logframe, select indicators and baselines, check data quality, plan mixed-methods evaluations, analyse outcome evidence, and communicate findings through results dashboards and reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, analyse, assure, or use evidence about international development results. It suits experienced practitioners who want to strengthen an existing M&E system and professionals moving into more advanced evaluation, learning, or results-management responsibilities.
audience: Development Programme Managers using evidence for adaptive
modules: Theory of Change and Logframe Design
prerequisites: You need access to a laptop for spreadsheet-based exercises. Power BI may be used where available, but the practical work can also run through structured spreadsheet templates. TrainingCred provides sample development-programme datasets, Theory of Change and logframe templates, indicator reference sheets, Data Quality Assessment checklists, evaluation matrices, and reporting formats. No coding experience or software development background is required.
